verdict.rationale: Maritime documents serving any Dockerfile-based repo on a public, no-login HTTPS URL that sleeps when idle and wakes on the next visit. That gives a public URL to a service running in its serverless environment. However, it is a whole-app deployment path, not a documented way to expose a chosen port from an agent's sandbox or VM as a preview URL. Missing for 10: explicit port-exposure or preview-URL capability for a running agent sandbox, control over which port or service is exposed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
